meta.title: {name} – All-in-one HR platform
meta.description: From onboarding and attendance to leave and payroll, run every HR process on one platform and give your HR team time back for people.

hero.description: From onboarding and attendance to leave and payroll, {name} brings scattered HR processes into one platform, automates the repetitive work, and gives managers a real-time view of their organization.

features.title: Everything HR does, in one platform
features.description: Hand the repetitive admin work to the system so your HR team can focus on what matters: people.

records.title: Employee records
records.desc: Keep profiles, contracts and job history in one place with role-based access, instead of spreadsheets scattered everywhere.

attendance.title: Time & attendance
attendance.desc: Clock in by mobile GPS or Wi-Fi, match against schedules automatically, and get alerts on exceptions.

leave.title: Leave & overtime
leave.desc: Online requests with multi-level approvals, automatic annual leave accrual, and self-service balances.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.desc: Pull in attendance and leave data, calculate insurance and tax automatically, and issue payslips in one click.

reports.title: Reports & analytics
reports.desc: Live dashboards for labor cost, turnover and attendance, so decisions are backed by data.

security.title: Security & compliance
security.desc: Encryption in transit and at rest plus full audit logs, aligned with privacy and labor regulations.

modules.title: HR workflows built for growing businesses
modules.description: Designed around how teams actually work, so everyone is productive from day one.

attendance.label: Attendance
attendance.title: Clock-ins, shifts and alerts on autopilot
attendance.desc: Employees clock in from their phones, the system flags late arrivals, early leaves and overtime against the schedule, and managers are notified instantly. No more month-end reconciliation.

leave.label: Leave approvals
leave.title: Approvals that never get stuck
leave.desc: Design multi-level approval flows, keep a full trail from request to approval, and let employees check their own leave balances, calculated automatically.

points.p3: Approve on the go with push notifications

payroll.label: Payroll
payroll.title: From timesheet to payslip in one click
payroll.desc: Attendance, leave and overtime flow straight into payroll. Insurance, pension and tax are calculated instantly, and digital payslips go out to every employee.

points.p1: Insurance brackets kept up to date
points.p2: Bank transfer files in one click

steps.title: Switch systems in three simple steps
steps.description: A dedicated consultant guides you all the way, no IT team required.

discovery.title: Discovery call
discovery.desc: A consultant learns your org structure, shifts and pay rules, then recommends a rollout plan.

setup.title: Data import & setup
setup.desc: We import your employee data and configure approval flows and pay items to match your current policies.

training.title: Training & go-live
training.desc: Hands-on training for HR and managers, with ongoing support after launch.

install.q: Do I need to install software or run a server?
install.a: No. It is a cloud service you can use from any browser or our mobile app, and we handle all updates for you.

customize.q: Can it fit our company policies?
customize.a: Yes. Shifts, leave types, approval flows and pay items are all configurable, and our consultants can help with special requirements.

migrate.q: Can we migrate data from our old system?
migrate.a: Yes. We provide Excel import templates, and a consultant will help review and convert your existing data.

security.a: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with daily backups, role-based access control and full audit logs.

pricing.a: Pricing is based on headcount and modules. Book a demo and we will prepare a quote for your needs.

cta.title: Ready to make HR work easier?
cta.description: Book a 30-minute online demo. A consultant will walk you through the product based on your needs and suggest a rollout plan.
